quality_metric_audit.normalization: lowercase; replace punctuation with spaces; remove a/an/the; collapse whitespace; compare against the first gold answer
quality_metric_audit.legacy_source_behavior: The stored runner score also accepts a prediction whose first normalized words equal the complete normalized gold answer.

canonical_dataset_config.disclaimer: The source paper specifies GQA testdev-balanced, 4,061 three-turn dialogues, but the exact dialogue artifact was unavailable at evaluation time. We therefore use a deterministic reconstruction and do not claim exact benchmark identity.
canonical_dataset_config.membership_rule: source-order contiguous triples within each image

canonical_dataset_provenance.disclaimer: The source paper specifies GQA testdev-balanced, 4,061 three-turn dialogues, but the exact dialogue artifact was unavailable at evaluation time. We therefore use a deterministic reconstruction and do not claim exact benchmark identity.

metacompress_repository_evidence.readme_status: Code implementation is being organized and will be released as soon as possible.

paper.title: Rethinking Token Reduction for Large Vision-Language Models

reconstruction.duplicate_policy: Preserve source-order membership. Exact normalized repeats across different dialogues are retained and disclosed; any repeat inside one source-order triple fails validation.
reconstruction.membership: For each image, preserve source JSON occurrence order and take consecutive non-overlapping triples up to floor(original_questions / 3).

conclusions.quality_rule: SUPPORTED iff both prefixes have Avg gap >= -2pp and T3-vs-T1 gap growth >= -2pp; PARTIAL iff one does.
conclusions.efficiency_rule: SUPPORTED iff both prefixes beat ReComp cache-hit TTFT and FullLoad SSD bytes; PARTIAL iff one does.

questions.Q1: MT-GQA-reconstructed; source and hashes are recorded in the immutable run config.
questions.Q2: Three questions from one image; Turn 2 receives Q1/gold A1/Q2 and Turn 3 receives Q1/gold A1/Q2/gold A2/Q3.
